text: This app is incredibly user friendly and makes it so easy to make my site more shoppable and provide a better customer experience. Splitting the variants out makes our small amount of products look much more substantial without being overwhelming. I had some reformatting that needed to be done for the app to work with my older theme and customer service was INCREDIBLE. They responded to emails quickly, and always knew exactly what my request or micro-change was so I didn't have to keep trying to explain. I am so excited to have it published on the store!

Excellent app. Does exactly as it says without any hidden costs. Very user friendly and intuitive and has helped us better organise our collections. The founder was also very responsible and helpful when needing assistance. Highly recommend!

Variantify is exactly what I needed for my store. It’s incredibly easy to set up and does a flawless job of splitting products into individual variations. On top of that, the customer support team is extremely fast and helpful. Highly recommend!

We switched to Variantify after the app we were using previously stopped working, and we were looking for something that would allow us to show variants directly on our collection pages. Variantify has been really easy and straightforward to use, and it has been a great fit for what we needed. We did have an issue at one point, but the support team has been amazing. They were quick to respond and fixed the issue really fast. Really happy with the app and, especially, the support we’ve received. Would definitely recommend it!

Outsanding support from the Variantify team. Team is responding quickly, very easy going in the conversations. Technically professionals with great attitude and actual will to help. Then beacuse of unusual setup ofmy bundled products multiple variants I had some troubles displaying correct products on the page. Even if it doesn't have the exact feature you are looking for - just ask the Variantify team, maybe there a chance to introduce it. Best regards

I tried a lot of apps looking for the right fix and this app solved all my problems. Very happy with the support. I was dealing with a small glitch and it was fixed within 24 hours. 10/10 would recommend to anyone who needs to split variants on their collection page and have the control of ordering them the exact way they want.

The app itself is super easy to use and offers some great features such as, being able to reorder not just product but specific variants too (a life saver!), an easy toggle on/off button for collections and more and all at a reasonable price! Not only that but I reached out other Siva to get a fix on a compatibility issue and it was fixed the same day. Fully recommend this app for those wanting to get more visibility on their variants!

great experience so far! super responsive when something goes wrong. Definitely the best app to use to help show all of the variant colors of each collection without having to make separate products listings and having to try and connect them. Would definitely recommend using this!

Great support from the onset! My issue was resolved immediately and the screenshots really help to understand what the issue is about. Keep up the great work!

Variantify solved a problem we couldn't crack natively in Shopify - splitting products by colour on collection pages so customers see the full range upfront, without losing the benefits of variant-based product setup. The flexibility to configure this differently across collections is particularly useful, as is the ability to curate collections to show only the relevant variants. Siva was extremely responsive throughout.

Variantify is the solution I have been looking for. We were having trouble merchandising certain collections on our website. This app allows much more control of what is displayed on a collection page, from multiple variants, to variant specific pricing. I had an issue with our theme and Siva (the founder) was able to get it fixed quickly and just in time for the beginning of a sale. Excellent app and incredible support.

Variantify has been a huge asset for our Shopify store. The app allows us to build highly targeted product collections using specific variant criteria that simply aren't possible with Shopify's native collection tools. When we encountered an issue where our theme wasn't communicating correctly with the app, Siva jumped in immediately. He was incredibly responsive, took the time to thoroughly investigate the problem, and worked diligently with our team until everything was fully resolved. What impressed us most was his commitment to finding a solution and the speed at which he helped us get back on track—especially since this happened right before a critical sales period for our business. Excellent app, outstanding support, and a founder who truly cares about his customers' success. Highly recommended.

This app has been a game changer for my site/shop. I am now able to create product collections based on very specific definition/variant selection. There was an issue with the app and my Shopify theme not communicating properly and this was researched and resolved quickly and with much determination by Siva, the Variantify founder. He was extremely responsive and worked with us to trouble-shoot until the matter was resolved.
Great app and fast support!

The app continuously improves its functionalities and effectively meets our needs. The team behind the app is always available to quickly develop new features or fix bugs, ensuring that the app remains well adapted to our website.
